DEMO CONTENT written by the builder: not pre-tested, merit tiers set by the builder (P1 rates them), Hinglish a draft. Counts, tie structures, which characters carry which cue, and every threshold the rating uses are PENDING v18. Consequence lines are equal in valence (candidates v17 3.17): different in content, never in success, keyed by the merit tier of the lead's notes, never by who carried them.

premise.en: 5 chapters in a busy warehouse, from the hiring sprint to the season close.
premise.hinglish: Ek busy warehouse mein 5 chapters, hiring sprint se season ke aakhir tak.

intro.en: You lead a team of 8 at Kite Logistics, a made-up warehouse company near Pune. The season runs in 5 chapters, with the same team throughout, and with applicants, vendors and other people passing through.
intro.hinglish: Aap Kite Logistics mein 8 logon ki team lead karte hain, Pune ke paas ek fictional warehouse company. Season 5 chapters mein chalta hai, poore time wahi team, aur beech mein applicants, vendors aur doosre log aate jaate hain.

body.en: You meet the team in person. Here is who was who on the team chat.
body.hinglish: Aap team se khud milte hain. Team chat par kaun kaun tha, yeh raha.

scene.en: Lotus Home wants a first plan for its big sale by Friday.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home ko apni badi sale ka pehla plan Friday tak chahiye.

question.en: Who should draft the peak plan?

text.en: Wrote the peak plans for 2 clients last year; both were signed off first time.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal 2 clients ke peak plan likhe; dono pehli baar mein approve hue.

text.en: Drafted last year's year-end plan; the client approved it without changes.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka year-end plan likha; client ne bina badlaav approve kiya.

text.en: Has reviewed plans for others; not yet written one alone.
text.hinglish: Doosron ke plans review kiye hain; akele abhi tak koi nahin likha.

text.en: New to client plans; strong on spreadsheets, still learning how plans are set out.
text.hinglish: Client plans mein naya; spreadsheet mein mazboot, plan ka format abhi seekhna baaki.

3.en: {name} sent the plan on Friday. Lotus Home's first question is about delivery slots.
3.hinglish: {name} ne Friday ko plan bheja. Lotus Home ka pehla sawaal delivery slots par hai.

1.en: {name} sent the plan on Friday. Lotus Home's first question is about staffing.
1.hinglish: {name} ne Friday ko plan bheja. Lotus Home ka pehla sawaal staffing par hai.

scene.en: 2 shifts each say the other missed a handover. 4 colleagues give an account.
scene.hinglish: 2 shifts ek doosre par handover chhodne ka ilzaam lagati hain. 4 colleagues bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most?
question.hinglish: Aap kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge?

text.en: Was at the handover and logged it in the shift book the same hour.
text.hinglish: Handover par maujood the aur usi ghante shift book mein likha.

text.en: Saw the handover and kept the scanner printout from it.
text.hinglish: Handover dekha aur uska scanner printout rakha.

text.en: Arrived after the handover and heard about it later.
text.hinglish: Handover ke baad pahunche aur baad mein suna.

text.en: Was off site that day and read about it in the chat.
text.hinglish: Us din site par nahin the aur chat mein padha.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the handover review, which starts from the shift book.
3.hinglish: Handover review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, shift book se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the handover review, which starts from the chat messages.
1.hinglish: Handover review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, chat messages se.

scene.en: The team's first video call is on Thursday.
scene.hinglish: Team ki pehli video call Thursday ko hai.

question.en: Snacks for the first team call?
question.hinglish: Pehli team call ke liye snacks?

text.en: Send each person a small snack box
text.hinglish: Har ek ko ek chhota snack box bhejein

after.en: The snack boxes arrive on Thursday morning. Cameras stay on.
after.hinglish: Snack boxes Thursday subah pahunch gaye. Camera on rahe.

text.en: Skip snacks this time
text.hinglish: Is baar snacks chhod dein

after.en: The call runs without snacks. It ends on time.
after.hinglish: Call bina snacks ke chali. Time par khatam hui.

text.en: Pay back anything people buy
text.hinglish: Jo bhi log khareedein, uska paisa lautayein

after.en: 12 receipts arrive by Friday, and accounts asks about each one.
after.hinglish: Friday tak 12 receipts aa gayi, aur accounts har ek ke baare mein pooch raha hai.

scene.en: The scanner maker offers 6 training days on the new handheld scanners.
scene.hinglish: Scanner company naye handheld scanners par 6 training din de rahi hai.

question.en: Who gets the 6 training days?

text.en: Will set up the scanners on the packing line; the training fits that job.
text.hinglish: Packing line par scanners lagane ka kaam; training usi kaam ke liye.

text.en: Trains new pickers every month; will pass the training on.
text.hinglish: Har mahine naye pickers ko training; yeh training aage sikhayi jaayegi.

text.en: Works in the office and rarely uses scanners.
text.hinglish: Office mein kaam; scanners ka istemaal kam.

3.en: {name} took the most training days and starts on the packing line.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada training din {name} ko mile; packing line se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most training days and starts in the office.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada training din {name} ko mile; office se shuru.

even.en: The training days were shared evenly. 3 colleagues know the new scanners.
even.hinglish: Training din barabar baante gaye. 3 colleagues naye scanners jaante hain.

scene.en: Lotus Home wants someone to walk the warehouse floor with them.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home chahta hai ki koi unke saath warehouse floor ghoome.

question.en: Who should lead the floor walk?

text.en: Led client floor walks for 4 peak seasons; spots bottlenecks early.
text.hinglish: 4 peak seasons mein client floor walks lead kiye; rukawatein jaldi pakadne mein achha.

text.en: Planned the current shelf layout; knows how stock moves through the floor.
text.hinglish: Abhi ka shelf layout plan kiya; floor par stock kaise chalta hai, achhi tarah pata.

text.en: Has joined 1 floor walk as a note taker.
text.hinglish: 1 floor walk mein note taker ke roop mein shaamil.

text.en: Mostly works on the budget side; has not walked the floor with a client.
text.hinglish: Zyadatar budget ka kaam; client ke saath floor walk nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} walked the floor with the client, starting at the dock.
3.hinglish: {name} ne client ke saath floor walk kiya, dock se shuru.

1.en: {name} walked the floor with the client, starting at the shelves.
1.hinglish: {name} ne client ke saath floor walk kiya, shelves se shuru.

scene.en: 40 temporary pickers apply in 1 week, and the interview panel needs a lead.
scene.hinglish: Ek hafte mein 40 temporary pickers apply karte hain, aur interview panel ko ek lead chahiye.

question.en: Who should lead the interview panel?

text.en: Led the interview panel for the last 2 peaks; most hires stayed the whole season.
text.hinglish: Pichhle 2 peaks mein interview panel lead kiya; zyadatar log poore season ruke.

text.en: Trained as an interviewer last year and runs the warehouse's skills tests.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal interviewer ki training li; warehouse ke skills tests chalane ka kaam.

text.en: Has sat on 1 panel as an observer.
text.hinglish: 1 panel mein observer ke roop mein baithe hain.

text.en: Has not interviewed anyone for the warehouse.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ke liye kisi ka interview nahin liya.

3.en: {name} leads the panel, which asks about past peaks first.
3.hinglish: Panel {name} lead karenge, jo pehle purane peaks ke baare mein poochhta hai.

1.en: {name} leads the panel, which asks about safety first.
1.hinglish: Panel {name} lead karenge, jo pehle safety ke baare mein poochhta hai.

scene.en: 4 outside applicants want the temporary shift supervisor job.
scene.hinglish: 4 bahari applicants temporary shift supervisor ki naukri chahte hain.

question.en: Who should get the supervisor job?
question.hinglish: Supervisor ki naukri kise milni chahiye?

text.en: Supervised a 40-person shift at a parcel hub for 2 peaks.
text.hinglish: Ek parcel hub par 2 peaks tak 40 logon ki shift supervise ki.

text.en: Ran the night shift at a cold store for 3 years.
text.hinglish: 3 saal ek cold store ki night shift chalayi.

text.en: Has worked as a picker for 1 season.
text.hinglish: 1 season picker ka kaam kiya.

text.en: Comes from retail; new to warehouse shifts.
text.hinglish: Retail se aaye hain; warehouse shifts mein naye.

3.en: {name} starts on Monday and asks for the shift plan in writing.
3.hinglish: {name} Monday se shuru karenge aur shift plan likhkar maangte hain.

1.en: {name} starts on Monday and asks to shadow a shift first.
1.hinglish: {name} Monday se shuru karenge aur pehle ek shift dekhna chahte hain.

scene.en: A first aid course has 6 places, and places can be split over 2 sessions.
scene.hinglish: First aid course mein 6 jagah hain, jo 2 sessions mein baanti ja sakti hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 course places?

text.en: Will be the first aider on the night shift.
text.hinglish: Night shift ke first aider honge.

text.en: Will be the first aider on the loading dock.
text.hinglish: Loading dock ke first aider honge.

text.en: Has no first aid role planned.
text.hinglish: Koi first aid role tay nahin.

3.en: {name} took the most places and will cover the night shift.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada jagah {name} ko mili; night shift cover karenge.

1.en: {name} took the most places and will cover the office.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada jagah {name} ko mili; office cover karenge.

even.en: The places were shared evenly. 3 first aiders cover the site.
even.hinglish: Jagah barabar baanti gayi. 3 first aiders site cover karte hain.

scene.en: Sale week needs 40 temporary pickers, trained and on a roster.
scene.hinglish: Sale week ke liye 40 temporary pickers chahiye, training aur roster ke saath.

question.en: Who should run the temp staff plan?

text.en: Recruited 30 temporary staff last peak and set up the roster; nobody missed a shift.
text.hinglish: Pichhle peak mein 30 temporary staff rakhe aur roster banaya; kisi ki shift nahin chhooti.

text.en: Runs the warehouse's training programme; has trained 200 new pickers.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ka training programme chalane ka kaam; 200 naye pickers ko training di.

text.en: Has helped on the induction desk once.
text.hinglish: Ek baar induction desk par madad ki.

text.en: Good with schedules in general; has not worked with temporary staff.
text.hinglish: Schedules mein aam taur par achha; temporary staff ke saath kaam nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} opened the temp roster, sorted by shift.
3.hinglish: {name} ne temp roster khola, shift ke hisaab se.

1.en: {name} opened the temp roster, sorted by zone.
1.hinglish: {name} ne temp roster khola, zone ke hisaab se.

scene.en: 4 applicants want the 2 forklift driver places.
scene.hinglish: 4 applicants 2 forklift driver jagahon ke liye aaye hain.

question.en: Who should drive for the peak?

text.en: Holds a forklift licence and 5 years at a port warehouse.
text.hinglish: Forklift licence hai aur port warehouse mein 5 saal.

text.en: Holds a forklift licence and drove for a cement depot for 4 years.
text.hinglish: Forklift licence hai aur 4 saal cement depot par chalaya.

text.en: Licence due next month; has driven a pallet truck.
text.hinglish: Licence agle mahine; pallet truck chalaya hai.

text.en: Has watched forklift training; no licence yet.
text.hinglish: Forklift training dekhi hai; abhi licence nahin.

3.en: {name} takes the first forklift and asks for the dock layout.
3.hinglish: {name} pehla forklift lete hain aur dock layout maangte hain.

1.en: {name} takes the first forklift and asks for a day of practice runs.
1.hinglish: {name} pehla forklift lete hain aur ek din practice maangte hain.

scene.en: 2 temporary pickers each say a supervisor shouted at them on the floor.
scene.hinglish: 2 temporary pickers kehte hain ki floor par ek supervisor ne un par chillaya.

question.en: Whose complaint do you take up first?

text.en: Gives the date, the bay and a colleague who heard it.
text.hinglish: Tareekh, bay aur sunne wale colleague ka naam dete hain.

text.en: Gives the date, the time and a colleague who saw it.
text.hinglish: Tareekh, time aur dekhne wale colleague ka naam dete hain.

2.en: You start with {name}'s complaint. The supervisor is asked for an account by Friday.
2.hinglish: Aap {name} ki shikayat se shuru karte hain. Supervisor se Friday tak bayaan maanga jaata hai.

scene.en: 12 suppliers need peak contracts this week.
scene.hinglish: Is hafte 12 suppliers ke peak contracts karne hain.

question.en: Who should lead the supplier deals?

text.en: Negotiated last peak's supplier contracts and saved 15 per cent.
text.hinglish: Pichhle peak ke supplier contracts tay kiye aur 15 percent bachaya.

text.en: Manages the warehouse's supplier list; has worked with 8 of the 12.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ki supplier list sambhalne ka kaam; 12 mein se 8 ke saath kaam kiya.

text.en: Has sat in on 2 supplier meetings.
text.hinglish: 2 supplier meetings mein baithe hain.

text.en: Strong on paperwork; has not negotiated a contract.
text.hinglish: Kaagzi kaam mein mazboot; koi contract tay nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} starts the supplier deals with the box makers.
3.hinglish: {name} supplier deals box banane walon se shuru karte hain.

1.en: {name} starts the supplier deals with the pallet yard.
1.hinglish: {name} supplier deals pallet yard se shuru karte hain.

scene.en: The client asks for a stock count on a Saturday.
scene.hinglish: Client Saturday ko stock count chahta hai.

question.en: What about the Saturday count?

text.en: Hold it, and give the team a comp-off
text.hinglish: Count karein, aur team ko ek comp-off dein

after.en: The Saturday count goes ahead. Monday is a quiet comp-off day.
after.hinglish: Saturday count ho gaya. Monday ko comp-off ka aaraam din hai.

text.en: Move it to a weekday evening
text.hinglish: Ise kisi weekday ki shaam par le jaayein

after.en: The count moves to Wednesday evening. 2 people join late.
after.hinglish: Count Wednesday shaam ko hua. 2 log der se jude.

text.en: Hold it with no comp-off
text.hinglish: Count karein, koi comp-off nahin

after.en: The count goes ahead. The team is tired on Monday.
after.hinglish: Count ho gaya. Monday ko team thaki hui hai.

scene.en: 4 applicants want the returns clerk job.
scene.hinglish: 4 applicants returns clerk ki naukri chahte hain.

question.en: Who should be the returns clerk?

text.en: Handled returns for an online fashion seller for 2 years.
text.hinglish: 2 saal ek online fashion seller ke returns sambhale.

text.en: Ran the customer returns counter at an electronics store.
text.hinglish: Ek electronics store ka returns counter chalaya.

text.en: Has done data entry; no returns work.
text.hinglish: Data entry kiya hai; returns ka kaam nahin.

text.en: Has worked in a shop; no returns work.
text.hinglish: Dukaan mein kaam kiya hai; returns ka kaam nahin.

3.en: {name} sets up the returns desk by the east door.
3.hinglish: {name} returns desk east door ke paas lagate hain.

1.en: {name} sets up the returns desk by the loading bay.
1.hinglish: {name} returns desk loading bay ke paas lagate hain.

scene.en: Someone has to stay late for 6 evening stock checks. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: 6 shaam ke stock checks ke liye kisi ko der tak rukna hai. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 stock checks?

text.en: Has no evening commitments this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine shaam ko koi zimmedaari nahin.

text.en: Works a late start this month and is on site in the evenings.
text.hinglish: Is mahine der se shuru karte hain aur shaam ko site par hain.

text.en: Leaves early 3 days a week this month for a course.
text.hinglish: Is mahine course ke liye hafte mein 3 din jaldi jaate hain.

3.en: {name} took the most checks. The counts start at 6 pm.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada checks {name} ke paas. Ginti 6 baje shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most checks. The counts start at 7 pm.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada checks {name} ke paas. Ginti 7 baje shuru.

even.en: The checks were shared evenly. Each person stays late twice.
even.hinglish: Checks barabar baante gaye. Har ek 2 baar der tak rukta hai.

scene.en: 2 colleagues each say the other changed the roster without asking.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues kehte hain ki doosre ne bina poochhe roster badla.

question.en: Whose account do you take first?

text.en: Has the roster as it was on Monday, saved from the team chat.
text.hinglish: Monday wala roster hai, team chat se save kiya.

text.en: Has the roster as it was on Monday, printed from the shared drive.
text.hinglish: Monday wala roster hai, shared drive se print kiya.

2.en: You take {name}'s account first. Roster changes now need 2 names.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} ka bayaan lete hain. Ab roster badalne ke liye 2 naam chahiye.

scene.en: The peak budget needs 1 owner.
scene.hinglish: Peak budget ka 1 owner chahiye.

question.en: Who should own the budget sheet?

text.en: Kept last year's peak budget within 1 per cent of plan.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka peak budget plan ke 1 percent ke andar rakha.

text.en: Runs the warehouse's monthly cost reports; spots overspends early.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ki monthly cost reports ka kaam; zyada kharch jaldi pakadne mein achha.

2.en: {name} owns the budget sheet now. The first version is shared with the client.
2.hinglish: Budget sheet ab {name} ke paas hai. Pehla version client ko bheja gaya.

scene.en: 2 complaints reach you on Monday, each saying a colleague took credit for their work.
scene.hinglish: Monday ko 2 shikayatein aati hain, dono mein kaha gaya ki kisi colleague ne unke kaam ka credit le liya.

question.en: Whose complaint do you take up first?
question.hinglish: Aap pehle kiski shikayat uthaate hain?

text.en: Says the new shift roster was presented as someone else's work; has the dated draft.
text.hinglish: Kehte hain ki naya shift roster kisi aur ke kaam ke roop mein dikhaya gaya; date wala draft hai.

text.en: Says the returns fix was claimed by someone else on the client call; has the emails.
text.hinglish: Kehte hain ki client call par returns fix ka credit kisi aur ne liya; emails hain.

2.en: You start with {name}'s complaint. Both complaints are looked into by the end of the week.
2.hinglish: Aap {name} ki shikayat se shuru karte hain. Hafte ke aakhir tak dono shikayaton ki jaanch ho jaati hai.

scene.en: There was a shouting match on the loading dock. 4 colleagues give you their account.
scene.hinglish: Loading dock par zor ki bahas hui. 4 colleagues apna bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most?
question.hinglish: Aap kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge?

text.en: Was on the dock throughout and wrote down what happened the same hour.
text.hinglish: Poore time dock par the aur usi ghante likh liya ki kya hua.

text.en: Was loading the next truck, saw all of it, and gave the same account twice.
text.hinglish: Agla truck load kar rahe the, sab dekha, aur 2 baar ek jaisa bayaan diya.

text.en: Arrived at the end and heard the rest from others.
text.hinglish: Aakhir mein pahunche aur baaki doosron se suna.

text.en: Was on a break and heard it from the canteen.
text.hinglish: Break par the aur canteen se suna.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the dock review, which starts from the shift logs.
3.hinglish: Dock review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, shift logs se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the dock review, which starts from what people remember.
1.hinglish: Dock review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, logon ki yaad se.

scene.en: 2 colleagues raise the same problem: overtime hours were left off their pay slips.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues ek hi pareshaani uthaate hain: overtime ke ghante pay slip mein nahin jude.

question.en: Whose problem goes to payroll first?
question.hinglish: Kiski pareshaani pehle payroll ko jaayegi?

text.en: Kept a daily log of hours that matches the gate records.
text.hinglish: Ghanton ka roz ka log rakha jo gate records se milta hai.

text.en: Has the shift lead's signed overtime sheet for each day.
text.hinglish: Har din ki shift lead ki sign ki hui overtime sheet hai.

2.en: {name}'s problem goes first. Payroll fixes both pay slips this month.
2.hinglish: {name} ki pareshaani pehle gayi. Payroll ne is mahine dono pay slips theek kar di.

scene.en: The team asks how problems should be raised from now on.
scene.hinglish: Team poochhti hai ki ab se pareshaaniyan kaise uthaayi jaayein.

question.en: How should problems be raised?

text.en: A simple form, with a reply within a week
text.hinglish: Ek seedha form, ek hafte mein jawab ke saath

after.en: The form goes up on the notice board.
after.hinglish: Form notice board par lag gaya.

text.en: Come and see me any time
text.hinglish: Kabhi bhi mujhse mil lijiye

after.en: 2 people come by. Others say they are not sure it is welcome.
after.hinglish: 2 log aaye. Baaki kehte hain unhe pakka nahin ki yeh theek rahega.

text.en: Raise it at the weekly meeting, in front of everyone
text.hinglish: Weekly meeting mein sabke saamne uthaiye

after.en: Nobody raises anything at the weekly meeting.
after.hinglish: Weekly meeting mein koi kuch nahin uthaata.

scene.en: 2 colleagues each ask for a quiet word: they are often spoken over in shift meetings.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues alag alag baat karna chahte hain: shift meetings mein unki baat aksar kaati jaati hai.

question.en: You have time for one this week. Who do you meet first?
question.hinglish: Is hafte ek ke liye time hai. Pehle kisse milenge?

text.en: Gives 3 recent examples, with the meeting dates.
text.hinglish: Haal ke 3 examples dete hain, meeting ki tareekhon ke saath.

text.en: Gives 3 recent examples, and a colleague confirms each one.
text.hinglish: Haal ke 3 examples dete hain, aur ek colleague har ek ko confirm karta hai.

2.en: You meet {name} first. Shift meetings get a round where everyone speaks once.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} se milte hain. Shift meetings mein ab har koi ek baar bolta hai.

scene.en: A pallet fell in aisle 9. Nobody was hurt. 4 colleagues give an account.
scene.hinglish: Aisle 9 mein ek pallet gira. Kisi ko chot nahin aayi. 4 colleagues bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most?
question.hinglish: Kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge?

text.en: Was in aisle 9 and photographed the rack straight after.
text.hinglish: Aisle 9 mein the aur turant rack ka photo liya.

text.en: Was driving past, saw it fall and logged it within the hour.
text.hinglish: Paas se guzar rahe the, girte dekha aur ghante bhar mein log kiya.

text.en: Heard the noise from the next aisle.
text.hinglish: Agle aisle se aawaaz suni.

text.en: Heard about it at lunch.
text.hinglish: Lunch par suna.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the pallet review, which starts from the written records.
3.hinglish: Pallet review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, likhe records se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the pallet review, which starts from what people remember.
1.hinglish: Pallet review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, logon ki yaad se.

scene.en: 4 outside candidates apply to coordinate next year's peak.
scene.hinglish: 4 bahari candidates agle saal ke peak ke coordinator ke liye apply karte hain.

question.en: Who should coordinate next year's peak?
question.hinglish: Agle saal ka peak kaun coordinate kare?

text.en: Coordinated 2 sale peaks for a marketplace warehouse.
text.hinglish: Ek marketplace warehouse ke 2 sale peaks coordinate kiye.

text.en: Planned the festive peak at a toy distributor for 3 years.
text.hinglish: 3 saal ek toy distributor ka tyohaar peak plan kiya.

text.en: Has worked 1 peak as a team member.
text.hinglish: 1 peak team member ke roop mein kiya hai.

text.en: Has planned events, not warehouse peaks.
text.hinglish: Events plan kiye hain, warehouse peaks nahin.

3.en: {name} starts in January with a supplier calendar.
3.hinglish: {name} January mein supplier calendar ke saath shuru karte hain.

1.en: {name} starts in January with a staffing calendar.
1.hinglish: {name} January mein staffing calendar ke saath shuru karte hain.

scene.en: Someone has to write up the complaint log after 6 meetings. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: 6 meetings ke baad shikayat log likhna hai. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 write-ups?

text.en: Has the lightest caseload this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine sabse halka kaam.

text.en: Has a light month and types quickly.
text.hinglish: Is mahine halka kaam aur tez typing.

text.en: Is covering 2 roles this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine 2 role sambhal rahe hain.

3.en: {name} took the most write-ups. The log uses a short form.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada write-ups {name} ke paas. Log chhota form istemaal karta hai.

1.en: {name} took the most write-ups. The log uses full notes.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada write-ups {name} ke paas. Log poore notes istemaal karta hai.

even.en: The write-ups were shared evenly. The log has 3 hands in it.
even.hinglish: Write-ups barabar baante gaye. Log mein 3 logon ka likha hai.

scene.en: 4 colleagues report safety problems. The safety meeting can take 2 this week.
scene.hinglish: 4 colleagues safety pareshaaniyan batate hain. Is hafte safety meeting 2 le sakti hai.

question.en: Whose problem goes to the safety meeting first?
question.hinglish: Kiski pareshaani pehle safety meeting mein jaayegi?

text.en: Photographed a cracked rack upright and logged the bay number.
text.hinglish: Toote rack ka photo liya aur bay number likha.

text.en: Measured a blocked fire exit route and logged it twice this month.
text.hinglish: Band fire exit raaste ko naapa aur is mahine 2 baar log kiya.

text.en: Mentions that the floor felt slippery somewhere last week.
text.hinglish: Kehte hain ki pichhle hafte kahin farsh fisalne wala laga.

text.en: Heard from someone that a forklift beeps oddly.
text.hinglish: Kisi se suna ki ek forklift ajeeb aawaaz karta hai.

3.en: {name}'s problem goes first. The meeting starts at the racks.
3.hinglish: {name} ki pareshaani pehle gayi. Meeting racks se shuru hoti hai.

1.en: {name}'s problem goes first. The meeting starts at the floor.
1.hinglish: {name} ki pareshaani pehle gayi. Meeting farsh se shuru hoti hai.

scene.en: 2 truck drivers each say the gate guard turned them away without a reason.
scene.hinglish: 2 truck drivers kehte hain ki gate guard ne bina wajah unhe lauta diya.

question.en: Whose complaint do you take up first?

text.en: Has the gate log time and the booking slip.
text.hinglish: Gate log ka time aur booking slip hai.

text.en: Has the booking slip and a photo of the gate queue.
text.hinglish: Booking slip aur gate ki line ka photo hai.

2.en: You start with {name}'s complaint. The gate log is checked that afternoon.
2.hinglish: Aap {name} ki shikayat se shuru karte hain. Usi dopahar gate log check hota hai.

scene.en: A customer complains about a damaged parcel. 2 colleagues packed orders at that table.
scene.hinglish: Ek customer toote parcel ki shikayat karta hai. Us table par 2 colleagues ne orders pack kiye.

question.en: Whose packing evidence do you send to the customer team?
question.hinglish: Kiska packing evidence customer team ko bhejenge?

text.en: Packed by the standard and photographed every parcel that morning.
text.hinglish: Standard ke hisaab se pack kiya aur us subah har parcel ka photo liya.

text.en: Packed by the standard and has the checker's sign-off for every parcel.
text.hinglish: Standard ke hisaab se pack kiya aur har parcel par checker ka sign-off hai.

2.en: {name}'s evidence goes to the customer team. The parcel was damaged in transit.
2.hinglish: {name} ka evidence customer team ko gaya. Parcel raaste mein toota tha.

scene.en: 3 outside trainers bid to run 6 sessions on raising problems at work.
scene.hinglish: 3 bahari trainers kaam par pareshaani uthaane par 6 sessions ke liye bid karte hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 sessions?

text.en: Has run these sessions at 3 warehouses this year.
text.hinglish: Is saal 3 warehouses mein yeh sessions chalaye.

text.en: Has run these sessions at 2 factories and a port.
text.hinglish: 2 factories aur ek port mein yeh sessions chalaye.

text.en: Runs general team building; new to this topic.
text.hinglish: Aam team building chalate hain; is topic mein naye.

3.en: {name} runs the most sessions, starting with the night shift.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada sessions {name} chalate hain, night shift se shuru.

1.en: {name} runs the most sessions, starting with the day shift.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada sessions {name} chalate hain, day shift se shuru.

even.en: The sessions were shared evenly. Each trainer runs 2.
even.hinglish: Sessions barabar baante gaye. Har trainer 2 chalata hai.

scene.en: 4 colleagues say the holiday roster went against them last year.
scene.hinglish: 4 colleagues kehte hain ki pichhle saal holiday roster unke khilaaf gaya.

question.en: Whose case do you look at first?

text.en: Worked every public holiday last year, by the roster records.
text.hinglish: Roster records ke hisaab se pichhle saal har public holiday par kaam kiya.

text.en: Was given no leave in either peak, by the roster records.
text.hinglish: Roster records ke hisaab se dono peaks mein koi chhutti nahin mili.

text.en: Had 1 holiday swapped, by agreement.
text.hinglish: Sehmati se ek chhutti badli gayi.

text.en: Had the leave asked for, by the roster records.
text.hinglish: Roster records ke hisaab se maangi gayi chhutti mili.

3.en: You look at {name}'s case first. The new roster starts from public holidays.
3.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} ka maamla dekhte hain. Naya roster public holidays se shuru hota hai.

1.en: You look at {name}'s case first. The new roster starts from swaps.
1.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} ka maamla dekhte hain. Naya roster swaps se shuru hota hai.

scene.en: The disputes have taken a week. The team is tense.
scene.hinglish: Jhagdon mein ek hafta laga. Team mein tanaav hai.

question.en: How do you close the week?

text.en: A short team meeting on what changes now
text.hinglish: Ab kya badlega, us par chhoti team meeting

after.en: The meeting is short. People leave knowing what changes.
after.hinglish: Meeting chhoti rahi. Log jaante hain ki kya badlega.

text.en: An email to everyone
text.hinglish: Sabko ek email

after.en: The email goes out. A few people reply.
after.hinglish: Email chala gaya. Kuch logon ne jawab diya.

text.en: Say nothing and move on
text.hinglish: Kuch na kahein aur aage badhein

after.en: Nobody is sure the matter is closed.
after.hinglish: Kisi ko pakka nahin ki maamla khatam hua.

scene.en: Sale week needs thousands of packing boxes.
scene.hinglish: Sale week ke liye hazaaron packing boxes chahiye.

question.en: Which box supplier?

text.en: The local supplier the warehouse has used before
text.hinglish: Local supplier jiske saath warehouse pehle kaam kar chuka hai

after.en: The local supplier delivers samples in 2 days.
after.hinglish: Local supplier ne 2 din mein samples bhej diye.

text.en: The cheapest supplier online
text.hinglish: Online sabse sasta supplier

after.en: The online samples arrive a week late, and a little thin.
after.hinglish: Online samples ek hafte der se aaye, aur thode patle.

text.en: Let each shift order its own
text.hinglish: Har shift apne boxes khud mangaye

after.en: 5 suppliers send 5 different box sizes.
after.hinglish: 5 suppliers ne 5 alag size ke boxes bheje.

scene.en: A forklift safety course runs over 6 days, and the days can be split between colleagues.
scene.hinglish: Forklift safety course 6 din ka hai, aur din colleagues mein baante ja sakte hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 course days?

text.en: Already runs the forklift checks; the course would make it official.
text.hinglish: Forklift checks pehle se sambhalne ka kaam; course se yeh official hoga.

text.en: Will lead the loading dock in sale week; the course covers exactly that.
text.hinglish: Sale week mein loading dock lead karne ka kaam; course bilkul usi ke baare mein.

text.en: Interested in safety work; no safety role in sale week.
text.hinglish: Safety ke kaam mein dilchaspi; sale week mein koi safety role nahin.

3.en: {name} took the most course days and starts at the loading dock.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada course din {name} ko mile; loading dock se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most course days and starts in the aisles.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada course din {name} ko mile; aisles se shuru.

even.en: The course days were shared evenly. 3 colleagues know the safety basics.
even.hinglish: Course din barabar baante gaye. 3 colleagues safety ki buniyadi baatein jaante hain.

scene.en: The truck company has pulled out, 10 days before the sale.
scene.hinglish: Sale se 10 din pehle truck company peeche hat gayi.

question.en: Who should handle the truck crisis?

text.en: Found replacement trucks at 2 days' notice during last year's peak.
text.hinglish: Pichhle peak mein 2 din ke notice par doosre trucks dhoondhe.

text.en: Has contacts at 3 truck firms; handled a cancelled booking last month.
text.hinglish: 3 truck firms mein jaan-pehchaan; pichhle mahine ek cancel booking sambhali.

text.en: Calm under pressure; has not dealt with a supplier problem.
text.hinglish: Dabaav mein shaant; supplier ke kisi problem se nahin nipte.

text.en: Joined the transport team recently; still learning who to call.
text.hinglish: Transport team mein haal hi mein shaamil; kise call karna hai, abhi seekhna baaki.

3.en: {name} calls the truck firms, starting with the nearest.
3.hinglish: {name} truck firms ko call karte hain, sabse paas wali se shuru.

1.en: {name} calls the truck firms, starting with the largest.
1.hinglish: {name} truck firms ko call karte hain, sabse badi se shuru.

scene.en: 3 local box makers can each take trial orders. There are 6 orders.
scene.hinglish: 3 local box banane wale trial orders le sakte hain. 6 orders hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 trial orders?

text.en: Supplies 2 other warehouses in Pune with no late orders this year.
text.hinglish: Pune ke 2 aur warehouses ko supply karte hain, is saal koi order der se nahin.

text.en: Makes boxes for a large electronics brand and passed its audit.
text.hinglish: Ek bade electronics brand ke boxes banate hain aur unka audit paas kiya.

text.en: Started making boxes this year.
text.hinglish: Is saal box banana shuru kiya.

3.en: {name} takes the most orders and delivers on Mondays.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada orders {name} lete hain aur Monday ko delivery karte hain.

1.en: {name} takes the most orders and delivers on Thursdays.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada orders {name} lete hain aur Thursday ko delivery karte hain.

even.en: The orders were shared evenly. Each maker takes 2.
even.hinglish: Orders barabar baante gaye. Har banane wala 2 leta hai.

scene.en: Someone has to take minutes at 6 client meetings. It is useful, but nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: 6 client meetings ke minutes kisi ko likhne hain. Kaam zaroori hai, par koi ise maangta nahin.

question.en: Who gets the 6 sets of minutes?

text.en: Has the lightest workload this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine sabse halka kaam.

text.en: Has a light month after finishing the budget work early.
text.hinglish: Budget ka kaam jaldi khatam hone ke baad is mahine kaam halka.

text.en: Is carrying 2 other deadlines this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine 2 aur deadlines saath mein.

3.en: {name} took the most minutes. The notes use the client's template.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada minutes {name} ke paas. Notes client ke template mein.

1.en: {name} took the most minutes. The notes use the team's template.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada minutes {name} ke paas. Notes team ke template mein.

even.en: The minutes were shared evenly. The notes go out within 2 days.
even.hinglish: Minutes barabar baante gaye. Notes 2 din ke andar nikal gaye.

scene.en: 2 colleagues disagree about how the stock miscount happened.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues mein behas hai ki stock ki ginti galat kaise hui.

question.en: Whose account goes in the incident report?
question.hinglish: Incident report mein kiska bayaan jaayega?

text.en: Matches the scanner records line by line.
text.hinglish: Scanner records se line dar line milta hai.

text.en: Remembers it differently from the scanner records.
text.hinglish: Scanner records se alag yaad hai.

3.en: {name}'s account goes in the report, beside the scanner records.
3.hinglish: {name} ka bayaan report mein gaya, scanner records ke saath.

1.en: {name}'s account goes in the report, beside the shift notes.
1.hinglish: {name} ka bayaan report mein gaya, shift notes ke saath.

scene.en: There are 6 days of visits to suppliers in Mumbai this month.
scene.hinglish: Is mahine Mumbai ke suppliers ke paas 6 din ki visits hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 visit days?

text.en: Manages the box and tape suppliers.
text.hinglish: Box aur tape suppliers sambhalte hain.

text.en: Manages the shelving and pallet suppliers.
text.hinglish: Shelving aur pallet suppliers sambhalte hain.

text.en: Has no supplier work this year.
text.hinglish: Is saal koi supplier kaam nahin.

3.en: {name} took the most visit days and starts with the box makers.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada visit din {name} ko mile; box banane walon se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most visit days and starts with the pallet yard.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada visit din {name} ko mile; pallet yard se shuru.

even.en: The visit days were shared evenly. 3 colleagues each see 2 suppliers.
even.hinglish: Visit din barabar baante gaye. 3 colleagues har ek 2 suppliers se milte hain.

scene.en: The forecast shows heavy rain in sale week.
scene.hinglish: Forecast ke hisaab se sale week mein tez baarish hogi.

question.en: What about the loading dock?

text.en: Book covers for the loading dock now
text.hinglish: Loading dock ke liye abhi covers book karein

after.en: The dock covers are booked.
after.hinglish: Dock covers book ho gaye.

text.en: Wait for a closer forecast
text.hinglish: Paas ke forecast ka intezaar karein

after.en: The forecast still says rain. Covers cost more now.
after.hinglish: Forecast ab bhi baarish bata raha hai. Covers ab mehenge hain.

text.en: Load the trucks in the rain
text.hinglish: Baarish mein hi trucks load karein

after.en: The client is not happy about wet boxes.
after.hinglish: Geele boxes se client khush nahin hai.

scene.en: The client wants someone on call on 6 weekend days. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: Client 6 weekend dinon par kisi ko on call chahta hai. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 on-call days?

text.en: Has no weekend plans this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine weekend ka koi plan nahin.

text.en: Prefers weekend work and takes weekdays off.
text.hinglish: Weekend kaam pasand hai aur weekdays chhutti lete hain.

text.en: Has family duties every weekend this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine har weekend family ki zimmedaari.

3.en: {name} took the most on-call days. Calls go to a work phone.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada on-call din {name} ke paas. Calls work phone par jaati hain.

1.en: {name} took the most on-call days. Calls go to a shared line.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada on-call din {name} ke paas. Calls shared line par jaati hain.

even.en: The on-call days were shared evenly. Each person takes 2.
even.hinglish: On-call din barabar baante gaye. Har ek 2 leta hai.

scene.en: 3 truck owners can take 6 extra runs in sale week.
scene.hinglish: 3 truck maalik sale week mein 6 extra runs le sakte hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 runs?

text.en: Has run sale week deliveries for this warehouse twice before.
text.hinglish: Is warehouse ke liye 2 baar sale week deliveries ki hain.

text.en: Runs a 10-truck fleet with a clean safety record.
text.hinglish: Saaf safety record ke saath 10 trucks chalate hain.

text.en: Has 1 truck and is new to warehouse work.
text.hinglish: 1 truck hai aur warehouse kaam mein naye.

3.en: {name} takes the most runs, starting at dawn.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada runs {name} lete hain, subah se shuru.

1.en: {name} takes the most runs, starting after lunch.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada runs {name} lete hain, lunch ke baad shuru.

even.en: The runs were shared evenly. Each owner takes 2.
even.hinglish: Runs barabar baante gaye. Har maalik 2 leta hai.

scene.en: Lotus Home's auditors will inspect the warehouse.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home ke auditors warehouse ki jaanch karenge.

question.en: Who should host the audit?

text.en: Hosted last year's client audit; it passed with no findings.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal ka client audit host kiya; bina kisi kami ke paas hua.

text.en: Former quality inspector; knows what auditors look for.
text.hinglish: Pehle quality inspector; auditors kya dekhte hain, achhi tarah pata.

text.en: Has prepared audit files; has not met auditors in person.
text.hinglish: Audit files taiyaar ki hain; auditors se kabhi mile nahin.

text.en: Prefers working behind the scenes; has not done audit work.
text.hinglish: Parde ke peeche kaam pasand; audit ka kaam nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} hosts the audit, which starts in the stock room.
3.hinglish: {name} audit host karte hain, jo stock room se shuru hota hai.

1.en: {name} hosts the audit, which starts with the paperwork.
1.hinglish: {name} audit host karte hain, jo kaagzon se shuru hota hai.

scene.en: An analytics consultant offers 6 hours of one to one help.
scene.hinglish: Ek analytics consultant 6 ghante ki one to one madad de raha hai.

question.en: Who gets the 6 hours?

text.en: Builds the stock dashboards and wants to add forecasts.
text.hinglish: Stock dashboards banate hain aur forecasts jodna chahte hain.

text.en: Runs the cost reports and wants to automate the reports.
text.hinglish: Cost reports chalate hain aur unhe automate karna chahte hain.

text.en: Rarely works with data.
text.hinglish: Data ke saath kam kaam.

3.en: {name} took the most hours and starts on stock forecasts.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada ghante {name} ko mile; stock forecasts se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most hours and starts on the shift data.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada ghante {name} ko mile; shift data se shuru.

even.en: The hours were shared evenly. 3 small projects begin.
even.hinglish: Ghante barabar baante gaye. 3 chhote projects shuru hote hain.

scene.en: A row broke out over who was left off the overtime list. 4 colleagues give an account.
scene.hinglish: Overtime list se kaun chhoota, is par behas hui. 4 colleagues bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most?
question.hinglish: Kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge?

text.en: Keeps the overtime list and has every version of it.
text.hinglish: Overtime list rakhte hain aur uske har version hain.

text.en: Was at the shift meeting where the list was drawn up and took notes.
text.hinglish: Shift meeting mein the jahan list bani aur notes liye.

text.en: Heard about the row from the canteen.
text.hinglish: Canteen se behas ke baare mein suna.

text.en: Was on leave that week.
text.hinglish: Us hafte chhutti par the.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the overtime list review, which starts from the written records.
3.hinglish: Overtime list review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, likhe records se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the overtime list review, which starts from what people remember.
1.hinglish: Overtime list review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, logon ki yaad se.

scene.en: The company director offers 6 hours of one to one mentoring.
scene.hinglish: Company director 6 ghante ki one to one mentoring de rahe hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 mentoring hours?

text.en: Is preparing to lead a site next year; the mentoring fits that plan.
text.hinglish: Agle saal ek site lead karne ki taiyaari; mentoring usi plan ke liye.

text.en: Has asked for help with client strategy, which the director knows well.
text.hinglish: Client strategy mein madad maangi hai, jo director achhi tarah jaante hain.

text.en: Has not asked for mentoring and is happy in the current role.
text.hinglish: Mentoring nahin maangi; abhi ke role mein khush.

3.en: {name} took the most mentoring hours, starting on Monday.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada mentoring ghante {name} ko mile, Monday se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most mentoring hours, starting on Friday.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada mentoring ghante {name} ko mile, Friday se shuru.

even.en: The mentoring hours were shared evenly. 3 first sessions are booked.
even.hinglish: Mentoring ghante barabar baante gaye. 3 pehle sessions book hue.

scene.en: The team is behind on labelling the new shelves.
scene.hinglish: Team naye shelves par label lagane mein peeche hai.

question.en: How do you catch up?

text.en: Hire 2 temporary helpers for a week
text.hinglish: Ek hafte ke liye 2 temporary helpers rakhein

after.en: The helpers start on Tuesday. The labels catch up.
after.hinglish: Helpers Tuesday se aaye. Labels ka kaam poora hone laga.

text.en: Ask for voluntary overtime
text.hinglish: Apni marzi se overtime ke liye poochhein

after.en: 3 people stay late twice. The labels are nearly done.
after.hinglish: 3 log 2 baar der tak ruke. Labels lagbhag ho gaye.

text.en: Skip the shelf labels
text.hinglish: Shelf labels chhod dein

after.en: Pickers ask where the shelf labels went.
after.hinglish: Pickers pooch rahe hain ki shelf labels kahan gaye.

scene.en: Lotus Home's directors want to hear the plan in person.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home ke directors plan khud sunna chahte hain.

question.en: Who should present the plan?

text.en: Presented to the company's 2 biggest clients this year; both renewed.
text.hinglish: Is saal company ke 2 sabse bade clients ko present kiya; dono ne contract badhaya.

text.en: Pitched last year's peak plan to a new client and won the contract.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal naye client ko peak plan pitch kiya aur contract jeeta.

text.en: Has presented inside the team; not yet to a client's directors.
text.hinglish: Team ke andar present kiya hai; client ke directors ko abhi tak nahin.

text.en: Knows the plan's numbers best; nervous in front of large groups.
text.hinglish: Plan ke numbers sabse achhe se pata; bade group ke saamne ghabrahat.

3.en: {name} presented the plan. The directors ask about costs first.
3.hinglish: {name} ne plan present kiya. Directors pehle kharchon par poochhte hain.

1.en: {name} presented the plan. The directors ask about timing first.
1.hinglish: {name} ne plan present kiya. Directors pehle time par poochhte hain.

scene.en: 4 outside candidates apply to be the warehouse's quality lead.
scene.hinglish: 4 bahari candidates warehouse ke quality lead ke liye apply karte hain.

question.en: Who should be the quality lead?

text.en: Led quality checks at a pharmacy distributor for 4 years.
text.hinglish: 4 saal ek pharmacy distributor par quality checks lead kiye.

text.en: Ran the audit programme at a food warehouse.
text.hinglish: Ek food warehouse ka audit programme chalaya.

text.en: Has assisted on 2 audits.
text.hinglish: 2 audits mein madad ki hai.

text.en: Strong with spreadsheets; new to quality work.
text.hinglish: Spreadsheets mein mazboot; quality ke kaam mein naye.

3.en: {name} starts with a walk round every bay.
3.hinglish: {name} har bay ka chakkar lagakar shuru karte hain.

1.en: {name} starts with the last year's audit reports.
1.hinglish: {name} pichhle saal ki audit reports se shuru karte hain.

scene.en: The monthly operations review has 6 speaking slots, seen by the directors.
scene.hinglish: Monthly operations review mein 6 bolne ke slots hain, jo directors dekhte hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 slots?

text.en: Led the supplier savings this quarter.
text.hinglish: Is quarter supplier bachat lead ki.

text.en: Led the shift changes this quarter.
text.hinglish: Is quarter shift badlaav lead kiye.

text.en: Has no project to report this quarter.
text.hinglish: Is quarter report karne ko koi project nahin.

3.en: {name} took the most slots and opens with the savings.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada slots {name} ko mile; bachat se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most slots and opens with the floor changes.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada slots {name} ko mile; floor badlaav se shuru.

even.en: The slots were shared evenly. 3 colleagues speak twice each.
even.hinglish: Slots barabar baante gaye. 3 colleagues har ek 2 baar bolte hain.

scene.en: Lotus Home says a call with the team turned rude. 4 colleagues were on it.
scene.hinglish: Lotus Home kehta hai ki team ke saath ek call mein badtameezi hui. 4 colleagues call par the.

question.en: Whose account of the call do you rely on most?
question.hinglish: Call ke kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge?

text.en: Took notes during the call and sent the notes to everyone after.
text.hinglish: Call ke dauraan notes liye aur baad mein sabko bheje.

text.en: Has the call recording the client agreed to.
text.hinglish: Client ki sehmati se hui call recording hai.

text.en: Joined the call 10 minutes late.
text.hinglish: Call mein 10 minute der se jude.

text.en: Was on mute and half listening.
text.hinglish: Mute par the aur aadha sun rahe the.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the client call review, which starts from the written records.
3.hinglish: Client call review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, likhe records se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the client call review, which starts from what people remember.
1.hinglish: Client call review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, logon ki yaad se.

scene.en: Sale week runs a night shift for the first time.
scene.hinglish: Sale week mein pehli baar night shift chalegi.

question.en: Who should lead the night shift?

text.en: Led the night shift through 2 peaks at another warehouse.
text.hinglish: Doosre warehouse mein 2 peaks tak night shift lead ki.

text.en: Ran last peak's busiest shift; every truck left on time.
text.hinglish: Pichhle peak ki sabse busy shift chalayi; har truck time par nikla.

text.en: Has covered 1 night shift.
text.hinglish: 1 night shift cover ki hai.

text.en: Keen to lead; has not run a shift.
text.hinglish: Lead karne ka shauk; koi shift nahin chalayi.

3.en: {name} leads the night shift, with breaks at midnight.
3.hinglish: Night shift {name} lead karenge, aadhi raat ko break ke saath.

1.en: {name} leads the night shift, with breaks at 2 am.
1.hinglish: Night shift {name} lead karenge, 2 baje break ke saath.

scene.en: 3 caterers can cover lunch on 6 sale days.
scene.hinglish: 3 caterers 6 sale dinon ka lunch cover kar sakte hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 lunch days?

text.en: Feeds 2 factories daily and has a top hygiene rating.
text.hinglish: Roz 2 factories ko khana deta hai aur hygiene rating sabse oonchi hai.

text.en: Caters for a hospital canteen and has a top hygiene rating.
text.hinglish: Hospital canteen ke liye cater karta hai aur hygiene rating sabse oonchi hai.

text.en: Caters small parties; no work canteens yet.
text.hinglish: Chhoti parties cater karta hai; abhi work canteen nahin.

3.en: {name} takes the most days, with a rice menu.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada din {name} lete hain, chawal ke menu ke saath.

1.en: {name} takes the most days, with a roti menu.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada din {name} lete hain, roti ke menu ke saath.

even.en: The days were shared evenly. Each caterer covers 2.
even.hinglish: Din barabar baante gaye. Har caterer 2 cover karta hai.

scene.en: 2 agency pickers each say a week's pay is missing.
scene.hinglish: 2 agency pickers kehte hain ki ek hafte ki tankhwah nahin aayi.

question.en: Whose complaint goes to the agency first?
question.hinglish: Kiski shikayat pehle agency ko jaayegi?

text.en: Has the signed timesheet for the week.
text.hinglish: Hafte ki sign ki hui timesheet hai.

text.en: Has the gate records for every day of the week.
text.hinglish: Hafte ke har din ke gate records hain.

2.en: {name}'s complaint goes first. The agency answers both by Monday.
2.hinglish: {name} ki shikayat pehle gayi. Agency Monday tak dono ka jawab deti hai.

scene.en: 4 outside candidates apply to supervise nights after the peak.
scene.hinglish: 4 bahari candidates peak ke baad raat ki supervision ke liye apply karte hain.

question.en: Who should supervise nights?

text.en: Supervised nights at a courier hub for 3 years.
text.hinglish: 3 saal ek courier hub par raat ki supervision ki.

text.en: Ran a 12-person night crew at a grocery depot.
text.hinglish: Ek grocery depot par 12 logon ki night crew chalayi.

text.en: Has worked nights as a loader.
text.hinglish: Raat mein loader ka kaam kiya hai.

text.en: Has supervised days only, in a small shop.
text.hinglish: Sirf din mein, ek chhoti dukaan mein supervision ki.

3.en: {name} takes the night keys and changes the break times.
3.hinglish: {name} raat ki chaabiyan lete hain aur break ka time badalte hain.

1.en: {name} takes the night keys and keeps the old break times.
1.hinglish: {name} raat ki chaabiyan lete hain aur purana break time rakhte hain.

scene.en: Sale week days are long.
scene.hinglish: Sale week ke din lambe hain.

question.en: How should the shifts work?

text.en: 3 shifts a day with proper breaks
text.hinglish: Din mein 3 shifts, theek se break ke saath

after.en: The shift plan is out. Everyone has a break.
after.hinglish: Shift plan aa gaya. Sabko break milta hai.

text.en: 2 long shifts, with snacks
text.hinglish: 2 lambi shifts, snacks ke saath

after.en: The shift plan is out. People ask about breaks.
after.hinglish: Shift plan aa gaya. Log break ke baare mein pooch rahe hain.

text.en: Decide on the day
text.hinglish: Usi din tay karein

after.en: Nobody knows when they are working yet.
after.hinglish: Abhi kisi ko nahin pata ki unki shift kab hai.

scene.en: 2 colleagues each say they are left off the team's planning emails.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues kehte hain ki unhe team ke planning emails se chhoda jaata hai.

question.en: You have time for one this week. Who do you meet first?
question.hinglish: Is hafte ek ke liye time hai. Pehle kisse milenge?

text.en: Lists 4 planning emails missed this month, with dates.
text.hinglish: Is mahine chhoote 4 planning emails, tareekhon ke saath.

text.en: Lists 4 planning emails missed this month, with the senders.
text.hinglish: Is mahine chhoote 4 planning emails, bhejne walon ke saath.

2.en: You meet {name} first. The planning list is rebuilt from the roster.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} se milte hain. Planning list roster se dobara banti hai.

scene.en: Someone has to tidy the break room on 6 days. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: 6 din break room saaf karna hai. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 days?

text.en: Starts shifts early and is first in the room.
text.hinglish: Shift jaldi shuru karte hain aur kamre mein pehle aate hain.

text.en: Takes the last break and is often the last in the room.
text.hinglish: Aakhri break lete hain aur aksar kamre mein aakhri hote hain.

text.en: Works mostly at the far dock this month.
text.hinglish: Is mahine zyadatar door wale dock par kaam.

3.en: {name} took the most days. Tidying happens at the start of the day.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada din {name} ke paas. Safai din ke shuru mein.

1.en: {name} took the most days. Tidying happens at the end of the day.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada din {name} ke paas. Safai din ke aakhir mein.

even.en: The days were shared evenly. Each person takes 2.
even.hinglish: Din barabar baante gaye. Har ek 2 leta hai.

scene.en: Lotus Home's managing director may visit on sale day.
scene.hinglish: Sale day par Lotus Home ke managing director aa sakte hain.

question.en: Who should host the visit?

text.en: Hosted 2 client directors at earlier peaks; knows the safety rules for visitors.
text.hinglish: Pehle ke peaks mein 2 client directors ko host kiya; visitors ke safety rules pata.

text.en: Ran last year's client tour; the client still mentions it.
text.hinglish: Pichhle saal client tour chalaya; client ab bhi uski baat karta hai.

text.en: Has met client visitors once, as part of a group.
text.hinglish: Ek baar group ke saath client visitors se mile.

text.en: Has not hosted a visit.
text.hinglish: Koi visit host nahin kiya.

3.en: {name} will host the director, starting at the packing tables.
3.hinglish: Director ko {name} host karenge, packing tables se shuru.

1.en: {name} will host the director, starting at the returns lane.
1.hinglish: Director ko {name} host karenge, returns lane se shuru.

scene.en: You can put 1 name forward for senior coordinator.
scene.hinglish: Senior coordinator ke liye aap 1 naam aage bhej sakte hain.

question.en: Whose name do you put forward?
question.hinglish: Aap kiska naam aage bhejte hain?

text.en: Led parts of the peak from the first week; colleagues often ask for advice.
text.hinglish: Pehle hafte se peak ke hisse lead kiye; colleagues aksar salaah maangte hain.

text.en: Took on the hardest parts of the peak and delivered each one; trusted by the client.
text.hinglish: Peak ke sabse mushkil hisse liye aur har ek poora kiya; client ka bharosa.

2.en: {name}'s name goes forward. The director will decide next month.
2.hinglish: {name} ka naam aage gaya. Director agle mahine decide karenge.

scene.en: The full dry run of sale day is on Saturday.
scene.hinglish: Sale day ka poora dry run Saturday ko hai.

question.en: Who should lead the dry run?

text.en: Led dry runs for 2 large launches; both ran clean.
text.hinglish: 2 bade launches ke dry run lead kiye; dono bina gadbad ke chale.

text.en: Knows the sale day plan best; has run every practice so far.
text.hinglish: Sale day ka plan sabse achhe se pata; ab tak ki har practice chalayi.

text.en: Will be on the gate in sale week; has not joined the practices.
text.hinglish: Sale week mein gate par duty; practices mein shaamil nahin.

text.en: Has joined 1 practice as a helper.
text.hinglish: 1 practice mein helper ke roop mein shaamil.

3.en: {name} led the dry run, which tested the morning shift.
3.hinglish: {name} ne dry run lead kiya, jisne subah ki shift parkhi.

1.en: {name} led the dry run, which tested the evening shift.
1.hinglish: {name} ne dry run lead kiya, jisne shaam ki shift parkhi.

scene.en: Trucks are unloaded at 5 am on each of 6 days. Nobody wants it.
scene.hinglish: 6 dinon tak har subah 5 baje trucks khaali karne hain. Yeh koi nahin chahta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 early shifts?

text.en: Lives 5 minutes from the warehouse.
text.hinglish: Warehouse se 5 minute ki doori par ghar.

text.en: Is an early riser and lives close to the warehouse.
text.hinglish: Subah jaldi uthne ki aadat, aur ghar warehouse ke paas.

text.en: Lives an hour and a half from the warehouse.
text.hinglish: Warehouse se dedh ghante ki doori par ghar.

3.en: {name} took the most early shifts. Unloading starts at the north dock.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada early shifts {name} ke paas. Unloading north dock se shuru.

1.en: {name} took the most early shifts. Unloading starts at the south dock.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada early shifts {name} ke paas. Unloading south dock se shuru.

even.en: The early shifts were shared evenly. Each person covers 2.
even.hinglish: Early shifts barabar baanti gayi. Har ek 2 cover karta hai.

scene.en: A pallet of sale stock is missing, and 2 shifts blame each other. 4 colleagues give an account.
scene.hinglish: Sale stock ka ek pallet gayab hai, aur 2 shifts ek doosre ko ilzaam lagati hain. 4 colleagues bayaan dete hain.

question.en: Whose account do you rely on most?
question.hinglish: Kiske bayaan par sabse zyada bharosa karenge?

text.en: Scanned the pallet in and has the scan record.
text.hinglish: Pallet scan karke andar liya aur scan record hai.

text.en: Counted the bay at the end of shift and logged the count.
text.hinglish: Shift ke aakhir mein bay gini aur ginti log ki.

text.en: Thinks the pallet went out on a truck, but did not see it.
text.hinglish: Lagta hai pallet truck par gaya, par dekha nahin.

text.en: Heard the stock was moved, from someone on another shift.
text.hinglish: Doosri shift ke kisi se suna ki stock hataya gaya.

3.en: {name}'s account opens the missing pallet review, which starts from the written records.
3.hinglish: Missing pallet review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, likhe records se.

1.en: {name}'s account opens the missing pallet review, which starts from what people remember.
1.hinglish: Missing pallet review {name} ke bayaan se shuru hota hai, logon ki yaad se.

scene.en: 6 hours of filing old invoices need doing. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: Puraane invoices file karne ke 6 ghante ka kaam hai. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 hours?

text.en: Has spare hours this week after a project ended.
text.hinglish: Project khatam hone ke baad is hafte khaali ghante.

text.en: Has spare hours this week and knows the old files.
text.hinglish: Is hafte khaali ghante aur puraani files pata hain.

text.en: Has a deadline every day this week.
text.hinglish: Is hafte roz deadline.

3.en: {name} took the most hours. The files go by supplier.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada ghante {name} ke paas. Files supplier ke hisaab se.

1.en: {name} took the most hours. The files go by month.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada ghante {name} ke paas. Files mahine ke hisaab se.

even.en: The hours were shared evenly. Each person files 2 hours.
even.hinglish: Ghante barabar baante gaye. Har ek 2 ghante file karta hai.

scene.en: Sale day opens with a briefing for all 3 shifts.
scene.hinglish: Sale day teeno shifts ki briefing se shuru hota hai.

question.en: Who should give the sale day briefing?

text.en: Gave the all hands briefing at the last 2 peaks; crews listened.
text.hinglish: Pichhle 2 peaks mein sabki briefing di; crew ne dhyaan se suna.

text.en: Runs the warehouse's weekly safety talks.
text.hinglish: Warehouse ki weekly safety talks chalane ka kaam.

text.en: Has spoken at team meetings, not to all shifts.
text.hinglish: Team meetings mein bole hain, sab shifts ke saamne nahin.

text.en: Prefers not to speak to large groups, but is willing.
text.hinglish: Bade group ke saamne bolna pasand nahin, par taiyaar.

3.en: {name} gave the briefing, starting with safety.
3.hinglish: {name} ne briefing di, safety se shuru.

1.en: {name} gave the briefing, starting with the order numbers.
1.hinglish: {name} ne briefing di, order numbers se shuru.

scene.en: 2 small sellers each say their parcels left with the wrong labels.
scene.hinglish: 2 chhote sellers kehte hain ki unke parcels galat label ke saath gaye.

question.en: Whose complaint do you take up first?

text.en: Sends photos of 5 parcels and the order numbers.
text.hinglish: 5 parcels ke photo aur order numbers bhejte hain.

text.en: Sends the customer emails for 5 parcels.
text.hinglish: 5 parcels ke customer emails bhejte hain.

2.en: You start with {name}'s parcels. The label printer is checked that day.
2.hinglish: Aap {name} ke parcels se shuru karte hain. Usi din label printer check hota hai.

scene.en: Next month's national logistics expo in Delhi has 6 day passes for the team.
scene.hinglish: Agle mahine Delhi mein national logistics expo ke 6 day passes team ke liye hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 expo day passes?

text.en: Will lead next year's peak; the expo is where the suppliers are.
text.hinglish: Agle saal ka peak lead karne ka kaam; expo mein hi suppliers milte hain.

text.en: Is building the warehouse's supplier list for next year.
text.hinglish: Agle saal ke liye warehouse ki supplier list banane ka kaam.

text.en: Has no project planned that needs the expo.
text.hinglish: Aisa koi project nahin jismein expo ki zaroorat ho.

3.en: {name} took the most passes and plans to meet the box makers.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada passes {name} ko mile; box banane walon se milne ka plan.

1.en: {name} took the most passes and plans to see the new scanners.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada passes {name} ko mile; naye scanners dekhne ka plan.

even.en: The passes were shared evenly. 3 colleagues will go for 2 days each.
even.hinglish: Passes barabar baante gaye. 3 colleagues har ek 2 din jaayenge.

scene.en: 4 colleagues raise problems about the break room. The meeting can take 2.
scene.hinglish: 4 colleagues break room ki pareshaaniyan uthaate hain. Meeting 2 le sakti hai.

question.en: Whose problem goes first?

text.en: Logged the broken water cooler on 3 days, with photos.
text.hinglish: 3 din toote water cooler ko photo ke saath log kiya.

text.en: Measured that the room seats 12 for a shift of 40.
text.hinglish: Naapa ki 40 ki shift ke liye kamra 12 ko bithata hai.

text.en: Says the room feels crowded sometimes.
text.hinglish: Kehte hain ki kamra kabhi kabhi bhara lagta hai.

text.en: Heard the fridge might be broken.
text.hinglish: Suna ki fridge shayad kharab hai.

3.en: {name}'s problem goes first. The meeting starts with the cooler.
3.hinglish: {name} ki pareshaani pehle gayi. Meeting cooler se shuru hoti hai.

1.en: {name}'s problem goes first. The meeting starts with the seating.
1.hinglish: {name} ki pareshaani pehle gayi. Meeting baithne ki jagah se shuru hoti hai.

scene.en: The company board wants the peak results presented.
scene.hinglish: Company board peak ke nateeje sunna chahta hai.

question.en: Who should present to the board?
question.hinglish: Board ke saamne kaun present karega?

text.en: Presented results to the board twice; both were well received.
text.hinglish: Board ko 2 baar nateeje present kiye; dono baar achha raha.

text.en: Built the peak's final numbers and knows every figure.
text.hinglish: Peak ke final numbers banaye; har aankda pata.

text.en: Has not presented to the board.
text.hinglish: Board ke saamne present nahin kiya.

text.en: Joined halfway through the season.
text.hinglish: Season ke beech mein shaamil hue.

3.en: {name} presented to the board, opening with the client's numbers.
3.hinglish: {name} ne board ko present kiya, client ke numbers se shuru.

1.en: {name} presented to the board, opening with the team's story.
1.hinglish: {name} ne board ko present kiya, team ki kahani se shuru.

scene.en: After sale week, 6 late shifts packing returns need covering. Nobody asks for it.
scene.hinglish: Sale week ke baad returns pack karne ki 6 late shifts cover karni hain. Yeh koi nahin maangta.

question.en: Who gets the 6 late shifts?

text.en: Lives close by and has no evening duties.
text.hinglish: Paas rehte hain aur shaam ki koi zimmedaari nahin.

text.en: Asked last month for more evening hours.
text.hinglish: Pichhle mahine shaam ke zyada ghante maange the.

text.en: Has a long commute home by bus.
text.hinglish: Ghar tak bus se lamba safar.

3.en: {name} took the most late shifts. Packing runs to 9 pm.
3.hinglish: Sabse zyada late shifts {name} ke paas. Packing 9 baje tak.

1.en: {name} took the most late shifts. Packing runs to 8 pm.
1.hinglish: Sabse zyada late shifts {name} ke paas. Packing 8 baje tak.

even.en: The late shifts were shared evenly. Each person covers 2.
even.hinglish: Late shifts barabar baanti gayi. Har ek 2 cover karta hai.

scene.en: Some of the peak budget is left over.
scene.hinglish: Peak budget ka kuch hissa bacha hai.

question.en: What do you do with it?

text.en: Return it to the client with the final report
text.hinglish: Final report ke saath client ko lauta dein

after.en: The client thanks you for the clear accounts.
after.hinglish: Saaf hisaab ke liye client ne shukriya kaha.

text.en: Spend it on a team dinner
text.hinglish: Team dinner par kharch karein

after.en: The team enjoys the dinner. The client asks about the bill.
after.hinglish: Team ko dinner pasand aaya. Client ne bill ke baare mein poochha.

text.en: Buy more shelving now
text.hinglish: Abhi aur shelving khareedein

after.en: Sale week is over. The shelving stays in its boxes.
after.hinglish: Sale week khatam ho chuka. Shelving dabbon mein hi padi hai.

scene.en: The company is opening a second site, and 1 person will run its first month.
scene.hinglish: Company doosri site khol rahi hai, aur ek colleague uska pehla mahina chalayega.

question.en: Who gets the stretch assignment?

text.en: Set up the returns lane this season and trained its first crew.
text.hinglish: Is season returns lane shuru ki aur pehli crew ko training di.

text.en: Set up the night shift this season and wrote its first roster.
text.hinglish: Is season night shift shuru ki aur pehla roster likha.

2.en: {name} will run the new site's first month, starting with the floor plan.
2.hinglish: Nayi site ka pehla mahina {name} chalayenge, floor plan se shuru karke.

scene.en: 2 colleagues each report a near miss with a reversing forklift.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues peeche jaate forklift ke saath near miss report karte hain.

question.en: Whose report goes into the safety log first?
question.hinglish: Kiski report pehle safety log mein jaayegi?

text.en: Gives the time, the aisle and the forklift number.
text.hinglish: Time, aisle aur forklift number dete hain.

text.en: Gives the time, the aisle and a colleague who saw it.
text.hinglish: Time, aisle aur dekhne wale colleague ka naam dete hain.

2.en: {name}'s report goes in first. Reversing alarms are checked that week.
2.hinglish: {name} ki report pehle gayi. Us hafte reversing alarms check hote hain.

scene.en: The company wants 1 name for the team lead shortlist.
scene.hinglish: Company team lead shortlist ke liye 1 naam chahti hai.

question.en: Whose name goes on the shortlist?

text.en: Led the peak's supplier work and kept every deal on budget.
text.hinglish: Peak ka supplier kaam lead kiya aur har deal budget mein rakhi.

text.en: Led the peak's staffing and kept every shift covered.
text.hinglish: Peak ki staffing lead ki aur har shift poori rakhi.

2.en: {name}'s name goes on the shortlist. Interviews are next month.
2.hinglish: {name} ka naam shortlist par gaya. Interviews agle mahine hain.

scene.en: The team wants to celebrate the peak.
scene.hinglish: Team peak ka jashn manana chahti hai.

question.en: When should the team celebrate?

text.en: Friday lunch, in working hours
text.hinglish: Friday lunch, kaam ke ghanton mein

after.en: Friday lunch is booked. Everyone can come.
after.hinglish: Friday lunch book ho gaya. Sab aa sakte hain.

text.en: Saturday night
text.hinglish: Saturday raat

after.en: Saturday night works for some. 3 people cannot come.
after.hinglish: Saturday raat kuch logon ke liye theek hai. 3 log nahin aa sakte.

text.en: Skip the celebration
text.hinglish: Jashn chhod dein

after.en: No celebration. The team chat goes quiet.
after.hinglish: Koi jashn nahin. Team chat shaant ho gayi.

scene.en: 2 colleagues each say a shift swap request went unanswered for a week.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues kehte hain ki unki shift swap request ek hafte tak bina jawab rahi.

question.en: Whose request do you look at first?

text.en: Sent the request by email and has the sent message.
text.hinglish: Email se request bheji aur bheja hua message hai.

text.en: Filled the swap form and has the form number.
text.hinglish: Swap form bhara aur form number hai.

2.en: You look at {name}'s request first. Swap requests now get an answer in 2 days.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} ki request dekhte hain. Ab swap requests ka jawab 2 din mein milta hai.

scene.en: Next quarter's new hires need 1 mentor from the team.
scene.hinglish: Agle quarter ke naye logon ko team se 1 mentor chahiye.

question.en: Who should mentor the new hires?
question.hinglish: Naye logon ka mentor kaun bane?

text.en: Trained the temporary pickers this season; most stayed to the end.
text.hinglish: Is season temporary pickers ko training di; zyadatar aakhir tak ruke.

text.en: Wrote the induction notes this season; every new hire used the notes.
text.hinglish: Is season induction notes likhe; har naye hire ne istemaal kiye.

2.en: {name} will mentor the new hires, starting with a floor walk.
2.hinglish: {name} naye logon ke mentor honge, floor walk se shuru karke.

scene.en: 2 colleagues each say an idea of theirs was presented by someone else.
scene.hinglish: 2 colleagues kehte hain ki unka idea kisi aur ne pesh kiya.

question.en: Whose problem do you take up first?

text.en: Has the dated message where the idea was first shared.
text.hinglish: Woh dated message hai jahan idea pehli baar share hua.

text.en: Has the meeting notes where the idea was first raised.
text.hinglish: Woh meeting notes hain jahan idea pehli baar utha.

2.en: You take up {name}'s problem first. Ideas now go in a shared log with names.
2.hinglish: Aap pehle {name} ki pareshaani uthaate hain. Ab ideas naamon ke saath ek shared log mein jaate hain.

premise.en: Peak season is coming. You start from head office, then staff up the warehouse.
premise.hinglish: Peak season aa raha hai. Aap head office se shuru karte hain, phir warehouse ke liye log jodte hain.

text.en: Wednesday. 40 new pickers arrive at once,
text.hinglish: Wednesday. 40 naye pickers ek saath aate hain,

text.en: and the canteen runs out of chairs.
text.hinglish: aur canteen mein kursiyan kam pad jaati hain.

text.en: The team carries crates in to sit on.
text.hinglish: Team baithne ke liye crates le aati hai.

opening.en: Peak season is coming. You start from head office, then staff up the warehouse.
opening.hinglish: Peak season aa raha hai. Aap head office se shuru karte hain, phir warehouse ke liye log jodte hain.

text.en: Friday. {a} unpacks the new scanners.
text.hinglish: Friday. {a} naye scanners kholte hain.

text.en: {b} sets out next week's roster.
text.hinglish: {b} agle hafte ka roster banate hain.

text.en: On Monday the new pickers start.
text.hinglish: Monday ko naye pickers aate hain.

text.en: Midweek. The complaints keep coming,
text.hinglish: Hafte ke beech. Shikayatein aati rehti hain,

text.en: and the team chat goes quiet.
text.hinglish: aur team chat shaant ho jaati hai.

text.en: Someone pins a note: one thing at a time.
text.hinglish: Koi ek note pin karta hai: ek waqt par ek kaam.

text.en: Monday. {a} answers the team chat from the dock.
text.hinglish: Monday. {a} dock se team chat ka jawab dete hain.

text.en: {b} pins up the new shift notes.
text.hinglish: {b} naye shift notes lagaate hain.

text.en: At 4 pm, both stop for tea.
text.hinglish: 4 baje dono chai ke liye rukte hain.

premise.en: Costs rise and a supplier pulls out. Every rupee and every hour matters.
premise.hinglish: Kharche badhte hain aur ek supplier peeche hat jaata hai. Har rupaya aur har ghanta keemti hai.

text.en: Thursday. The finance team sends the new budget in red ink.
text.hinglish: Thursday. Finance team naya budget laal syahi mein bhejti hai.

text.en: The coffee machine breaks.
text.hinglish: Coffee machine kharab ho jaati hai.

text.en: Nobody mentions it.

debrief.en: The season measured attitudes towards women and men, and also towards religion, skin tone, caste and place of birth. It did this through decisions about colleagues with equally strong descriptions.
debrief.hinglish: Is season ne mahila aur purush ke baare mein attitudes naape. Religion, skin tone, caste aur kahan paida hue, inke baare mein bhi. Yeh un colleagues ke baare mein decisions se naape gaye, jinke descriptions barabar mazboot the.

debrief.en: After you submit, you see your own result, read from this season's decisions only. It is shown to you alone. It is stored only if you save it to an optional profile.

debrief.en: Anything here may bring up a real situation at work. If so, you can contact your Internal Committee (the complaints committee your employer must have). You can also contact your district's Local Committee (for workplaces without one). Or use the SHe-Box portal (the government's online complaint site).
debrief.hinglish: Yahan ki koi baat kaam ki kisi asli situation ki yaad dila sakti hai. Aisa ho to aap apni Internal Committee se contact kar sakte hain (woh complaints committee jo employer ke paas honi zaroori hai). Aap apne district ki Local Committee se bhi contact kar sakte hain (jahan Internal Committee nahin hai, wahan ke liye). Ya SHe-Box portal use kar sakte hain (sarkar ki online complaint site).

consent.en: This is a game season you play once, on your own device. You make decisions about fictional colleagues. Then you answer a few statements outside the game.
consent.hinglish: Yeh ek game season hai jo aap ek baar, apne device par khelte hain. Aap fictional colleagues ke baare mein decisions lete hain. Phir game ke bahar kuch baaton ka jawab dete hain.

consent.en: At the end you see your own result, worked out from your decisions. It is shown only to you. You can choose to save it to an optional profile under a name you make up. Your answers carry no real name and no contact details.
consent.hinglish: Aakhir mein aap apna result dekhte hain, jo aapke decisions se nikala gaya hai. Yeh sirf aapko dikhta hai. Aap chahein to ise apne banaye naam wale optional profile mein save kar sakte hain. Aapke jawabon mein na asli naam hai na contact.

consent.en: At the end you get a code. After all play in the study closes, a page explaining the study opens with that code. With the code you can use 'Delete my answers' until 2 weeks after that page opens.
consent.hinglish: Aakhir mein aapko ek code milta hai. Study ka saara khel band hone ke baad, us code se study samjhane wala page khulta hai. Us page ke khulne ke 2 hafte baad tak aap code se 'Mere jawab mita dein' use kar sakte hain.

consent.en: Taking part is voluntary, and you can stop at any time.
consent.hinglish: Hissa lena aapki marzi hai, aur aap kabhi bhi ruk sakte hain.

consent.en: Something in the game may bring up a real situation at work. If so, you can contact your Internal Committee (the complaints committee your employer must have). consent.hinglish: Game mein koi baat kaam ki kisi asli situation ki yaad dila sakti hai.
