tags._note: EVAL-10 (owner): the five tags. The thresholds behind them stay in config.season.rating.levels (PENDING v20; v22 will likely use a posterior model), never in player copy.

possible.en: Maybe a pattern: {group} first a little more often
possible.hinglish: Shayad pattern: {group} thoda zyada baar pehle

none.hinglish: Koi pattern nahin: {group} lagbhag barabar pehle

strong.en: In pairs with equally strong descriptions, you put {group} first far more often. That is unlikely to be chance. No single decision decided it; it shows across the season. This is one season of a made-up warehouse, not a verdict on who you are.
strong.hinglish: Barabar mazboot description wali jodiyon mein aapne {group} ko kaafi zyada baar pehle rakha. Yeh ittefaq hona mushkil hai. Kisi ek decision se yeh tay nahin hua; yeh poore season mein dikhta hai. Yeh ek banaye hue warehouse ka ek season hai, aap kaun hain is par faisla nahin.

moderate.en: In pairs with equally strong descriptions, you put {group} first more often. That is unlikely to be chance alone, but one season is a short look. No single decision decided it.
moderate.hinglish: Barabar mazboot description wali jodiyon mein aapne {group} ko zyada baar pehle rakha. Yeh sirf ittefaq hona mushkil hai, par ek season chhoti si jhalak hai. Kisi ek decision se yeh tay nahin hua.

possible.en: In pairs with equally strong descriptions, you put {group} first a little more often. Chance could also give this, so treat it as a maybe. More seasons would tell.
possible.hinglish: Barabar mazboot description wali jodiyon mein aapne {group} ko thoda zyada baar pehle rakha. Yeh ittefaq se bhi ho sakta hai, isliye ise shayad samjhiye. Aur seasons se pata chalega.

none.en: In pairs with equally strong descriptions, you put {both} first about equally. One short season can still miss a small pattern.
none.hinglish: Barabar mazboot description wali jodiyon mein aapne {both} ko lagbhag barabar pehle rakha. Ek chhota season phir bhi chhota pattern chhod sakta hai.

unread.en: We cannot give you a result this time. There were too few pairs with equally strong descriptions to tell.
unread.hinglish: Is baar hum aapko result nahin de sakte. Barabar mazboot description wali jodiyan bahut kam thi.

unengaged.en: We cannot give you a result this time. In many decisions you chose differently from what the descriptions pointed to, so the pairs cannot tell us enough.
unengaged.hinglish: Is baar hum aapko result nahin de sakte. Kai decisions mein aapne description se alag chuna, isliye jodiyon se kaafi pata nahin chalta.

shareResult.en: My result on women and men: {tag}.
shareResult.hinglish: Mahila aur purush par mera result: {tag}.

shareChancePattern.en: By chance alone, about 1 in {n} players who go by the descriptions get this tag or a clearer one.
shareChancePattern.hinglish: Sirf ittefaq se, description ke hisaab se chalne wale lagbhag {n} mein se 1 player ko yeh ya isse saaf tag milta hai.

shareChanceMany.en: By chance alone, about {k} in {of} players who go by the descriptions get this tag or a clearer one.
shareChanceMany.hinglish: Sirf ittefaq se, description ke hisaab se chalne wale lagbhag {of} mein se {k} players ko yeh ya isse saaf tag milta hai.

shareChanceNone.en: About {k} in {of} players who go by the descriptions alone get this tag.
shareChanceNone.hinglish: Sirf description ke hisaab se chalne wale lagbhag {of} mein se {k} players ko yeh tag milta hai.

shareChanceNoneOne.en: About 1 in {n} players who go by the descriptions alone get this tag.
shareChanceNoneOne.hinglish: Sirf description ke hisaab se chalne wale lagbhag {n} mein se 1 player ko yeh tag milta hai.

pairIs.en: A pair is a woman and a man with equally strong descriptions, side by side in one decision.
pairIs.hinglish: Jodi: ek mahila aur ek purush jinke description barabar mazboot the, ek hi decision mein saath saath.

rangeNote.en: The dot is your result. The shaded range shows where it could fall in another season like this one.
rangeNote.hinglish: Bindu aapka result hai. Shaded hissa dikhata hai ki aise kisi aur season mein result kahan aa sakta tha.

rangeSaid.en: {tag}. Your dot: women first in {at} per cent of pairs; the range runs from {lo} to {hi} per cent.
rangeSaid.hinglish: {tag}. Aapka bindu: {at} percent jodiyon mein mahila pehle; range {lo} se {hi} percent tak.

profile._note: The optional pseudonymous profile (EVAL-4, owner decision 19 Oct 2026: retakes are in). The longitudinal research consent and the change rule are PENDING v18.

saveTitle.hinglish: Ise rakhiye aur baad mein dobara kheliye

retake.en: Retake later to see how your decisions change. A retake is a different season with a new team.
retake.hinglish: Baad mein dobara kheliye aur dekhiye ki aapke decisions kaise badalte hain. Dobara khelna ek alag season hai, nayi team ke saath.

saveBody.en: Save this result to a profile with any name you like. There is no email and no password: a recovery code opens it.
saveBody.hinglish: Is result ko apni pasand ke kisi bhi naam wali profile mein save kijiye. Na email, na password: ek recovery code se profile khulti hai.

nameLabel.en: A display name (any name you like)

create.hinglish: Meri profile banayein aur save karein

saved.hinglish: {name} ki profile mein save ho gaya.

failed.en: The profile could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
failed.hinglish: Profile save nahin ho saki. Connection check karke dobara koshish kijiye.

recoveryBody.en: This code is the only way back into your profile: there is no email and no password. Write it down or take a screenshot. It is not the code you got at the end of the season.
recoveryBody.hinglish: Yeh code hi aapki profile mein wapas aane ka akela raasta hai: na email, na password. Ise likh lijiye ya screenshot le lijiye. Yeh woh code nahin hai jo season ke aakhir mein mila tha.

lockedBody.en: Enter your recovery code to open your profile.
lockedBody.hinglish: Apni profile kholne ke liye recovery code likhiye.

badCode.en: No profile opens with that code. Check it and try again.
badCode.hinglish: Is code se koi profile nahin khulti. Check karke dobara koshish kijiye.

demoNote.en: Demo: this profile's two past seasons are made up, in seasons that are not built yet, so the timeline can be seen.
demoNote.hinglish: Demo: is profile ke do purane season kaalpanik hain, un seasons mein jo abhi bane nahin, taaki timeline dikh sake.

noChange.hinglish: Abhi koi badlaav nahin dikhaya gaya.

change.en: Change shown: from {from} to {to}, your result moved towards {group} first, and the two ranges do not overlap.
change.hinglish: Badlaav dikha: {from} se {to} tak, aapka result {group} pehle ki taraf gaya, aur dono ranges ek doosre par nahin aati.

retakeBody.en: A retake is a season you have not played, with a new team. In a study, your next link comes from the study team.
retakeBody.hinglish: Dobara khelna ek aisa season hai jo aapne nahin khela, nayi team ke saath. Study mein aapka agla link study team se aata hai.

noStoryLeft.en: Every season open to you has been played on this profile. The other seasons open later.
noStoryLeft.hinglish: Is profile par har khula season khela ja chuka hai. Baaki seasons baad mein khulenge.

researchConsent.en: If you agree, the study team may link the seasons saved on this profile, to study how decisions change over time. They still never learn your name or contact details.
researchConsent.hinglish: Agar aap sehmat hain, to study team is profile par save hue seasons ko jod sakti hai, yeh samajhne ke liye ki decisions samay ke saath kaise badalte hain. Unhe phir bhi aapka naam ya contact kabhi pata nahin chalta.

researchConsent.en: Without it, your saved seasons stay unlinked for research. You can turn this off at any time, and turning it off deletes the link.
researchConsent.hinglish: Iske bina, aapke save kiye seasons research ke liye alag hi rehte hain. Aap ise kabhi bhi band kar sakte hain, aur band karne se link mit jaata hai.

researchAgree.en: I agree to longitudinal research use of my saved seasons
researchAgree.hinglish: Main apne save kiye seasons ke lambe research mein istemaal ke liye sehmat hoon

researchOn.hinglish: Lambi research ka istemaal chalu hai.

researchOff.hinglish: Lambi research ka istemaal band hai.

deleteButton.en: Delete my profile and all my answers
deleteButton.hinglish: Meri profile aur mere saare jawab mita dein

deleteConfirm.en: This deletes your profile, its research link, and the answers of every saved season you can still delete. It cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm.hinglish: Isse aapki profile, uska research link, aur har save kiye season ke woh jawab mit jaate hain jo abhi mitaaye ja sakte hain. Ise wapas nahin kiya ja sakta.

deleted.en: Your profile is deleted. Seasons deleted: {w}. Seasons past their deletion date, kept with nothing linking them to you: {c}.
deleted.hinglish: Aapki profile mit gayi. Mitaaye gaye seasons: {w}. Mitaane ki date ke baad wale seasons, jo aapse bina kisi link ke rakhe gaye: {c}.

lock.en: Close my profile on this device
lock.hinglish: Is device par meri profile band karein

_devChangePending.en: Demo: the range maths behind the change line is a planning value, PENDING v22.
_devChangePending.hinglish: Demo: badlaav ki line ke peeche range ka hisaab ek planning value hai, PENDING v22.

profile._researchConsentPending: PENDING v18: this consent text is a draft for the owner and the ethics review.

timelineNote.en: Two results can differ by chance; overlapping ranges mean no change shown.
timelineNote.hinglish: Do results ittefaq se alag ho sakte hain; agar ranges ek doosre par aati hain, to koi badlaav nahin dikhaya jaata.

practice._note: EVAL-10 (owner): the opt-in practice round. Mascots doing things that are not work, so no item carries a cue (content-check). Never recorded or scored: the record says only practice y or n.

offerBody.en: 3 practice decisions with the mascots, about a picnic. Practice answers are not kept.
offerBody.hinglish: Mascots ke saath picnic ke 3 practice decisions. Practice ke jawab rakhe nahin jaate.

scene.en: The team picnic has a quiz, and 4 mascots want to read out the questions.
scene.hinglish: Team picnic mein ek quiz hai, aur 4 mascots sawaal padhna chahte hain.

question.en: Who should read out the quiz questions?

hint.en: Practice: tap them in order, first choice first, then confirm.
hint.hinglish: Practice: order mein tap kijiye, pehli pasand pehle, phir pakka kijiye.

text.en: Has a loud, clear voice.
text.hinglish: Awaaz tez aur saaf hai.

text.en: Wrote half the questions.
text.hinglish: Aadhe sawaal isne likhe.

text.en: Has never run a quiz.
text.hinglish: Kabhi quiz nahin chalaya.

text.en: Sometimes reads the answers out by mistake.
text.hinglish: Kabhi kabhi galti se jawab padh deta hai.

scene.en: There are 6 slices of cake left at the picnic.
scene.hinglish: Picnic mein cake ke 6 tukde bache hain.

question.en: Who gets the 6 slices of cake?

hint.en: Practice: tap a number for each, until nothing is left, then confirm.
hint.hinglish: Practice: har ek ke liye number tap kijiye, jab tak kuch na bache, phir pakka kijiye.

text.en: Baked the cake.
text.hinglish: Cake isne banaya.

text.en: Skipped lunch.
text.hinglish: Lunch nahin kiya.

text.en: Is not very hungry.
text.hinglish: Zyada bhookh nahin hai.

scene.en: 2 mascots each want to start a picnic game.
scene.hinglish: 2 mascots ek ek picnic game shuru karna chahte hain.

question.en: Whose game do you play first?

hint.en: Practice: tap one to choose it.
hint.hinglish: Practice: chunne ke liye ek tap kijiye.

text.en: A relay race with spoons.
text.hinglish: Chammach ke saath relay race.

text.en: A quiz about films.
text.hinglish: Filmon par quiz.
